'Verification' has no fenced code block (card_validator requires at least one ``` block)
'Files expected to change' has no path-like line (card_validator requires at least one `dir/file` style entry)
'Files expected to change' contains only placeholder text

source_artifact.content_excerpt: Orchestrate has no way to check a plan without acting on it. The only entry point that reads a plan is start, which creates worktrees and writes the run record, so the first sign that a plan is malformed is a partly created run. Found during the Auralis preflight on installed Orchestrate 3.0.7.
source_artifact.title: s5

title: Orchestrate has no non-mutating plan validator so a bad plan is only discovered by starting a run
